sources: RIDB campsite catalog for facility 232432 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: $30 a night per site (group sites $75), plus recreation.gov's administrative fee when reserved. $15 a night with a Senior or Access pass. Shenandoah charges $30 per vehicle to enter, valid one week.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232432 (fee description; notice 'There is a $30 fee per vehicle to enter the park. The pass issued is valid for one week.') + /rates (2026 Peak Season Apr 29 - Nov 1: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 30)

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232432 ('$15.00 per night/per site with an Access (disability/golden age) or Senior Pass')

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232432 (notice: 'There are no RV hook-ups but there is a dump station with potable water available.')

values.note: No showers at the campground or the nearest wayside. Camping supplies, food and firewood at Elkwallow Wayside, 2 miles south.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232432 (Facilities: 'flush toilets, drinking water and one dump station ... There are no showers in this campground'; notice 'There are no showers available at this campground or the closest wayside')

values.note: 2026 dates (April 29 to November 1) from NPS's campground table; dates are set each year.

season.source: https://www.nps.gov/shen/planyourvisit/hours.htm (Campgrounds table: Mathews Arm 2026 opening April 29, closing November 1; last updated 2026-09-22)

values.note: Campsites by reservation and first-come, first-served. Reservable sites release in waves: 50% six months before arrival, 25% two weeks before, the remaining 25% four days before. 'No reservations can be made for Mathews Arm Campground 48 hours before your selected date.' First-come sites are claimed on site; check in at the registration office.

164 sites in the recreation.gov catalog (161 standard, 112 of them reservable and 49 walk-up, plus 3 group sites) and 2 management sites; the description says 'nearly 166'. Reservable sites list vehicle lengths up to 50 ft, most 28-46; 19 pull-throughs.

sites.source: RIDB campsite catalog for facility 232432 (fetched 2026-10-20) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232432 description

summary: Confirmed $30 base and no electric. Added water/sewer false, Senior/Access $15, $30/week park entrance, 2026 season Apr 29-Nov 1, reservation plus first-come with release waves and the 48-hour reservation cutoff, flush toilets/water/dump, showers false, 164 sites up to 50 ft with pull-throughs. Not stated: max stay.
